name: Nectar
description:
Nectar Social connects Claude to your brand's social performance, competitor benchmarks, and community conversations across platforms.

Ask how your content performed this week, how a competitor's launch landed, or what your customers are complaining about in the comments across paid and organic, and get answers grounded in real social data, combined with everything else Claude knows about your business.

Built for marketing, social, influencer, and competitive intelligence teams and agencies who want faster, data-grounded decisions.

Requires a Nectar Social account (https://www.nectarsocial.com).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nectar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nectar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nectarsocial.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nectar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nectar lists 16 MCP tools, including get_account_metrics, get_available_accounts, get_available_competitor_groups, get_available_competitors, get_available_labels, get_available_products, get_available_workspaces, get_community_content, get_community_sentiment_summary, get_competitor_comparison, get_competitor_summary, and get_competitor_trend.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nectar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nectar in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Nectar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nectar is developed by Nectar. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
